crypto.createHash: md5, sha1, sha2 (incl. sha512-224/256), sha3, shake128/256, md5-sha1, ripemd160, blake2b512/blake2s256, sm3 (the last four from the Rust helper); a stream when `node:stream` is linked
crypto.createHmac: the same digests except shake; a stream when `node:stream` is linked

crypto.createDecipheriv: AES-128/192/256 in ECB, CBC, CTR, CCM and GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, ChaCha20; a stream when `node:stream` is linked
module.createRequire: the require it returns fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND (modules are linked at build time)
